decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a cheap accessory option that complements the core flooring line, and with only one year of uncertain results it is worth keeping open at little cost.
Maintenance oil is closely tied to oiled floor sales and costs little to keep listed, so management keeps the option while its value becomes clearer.
This care product partly overlaps with the soap and oil, but holding it in the accessory range costs little and the early evidence does not yet justify abandoning it.
An underlay with moisture protection is a functional add-on bought with floor installations, and keeping it is low-cost while demand from installers is still being revealed.
A high-density underlay broadens the system offer for trade buyers at modest holding cost, so the option stays open until results show whether it is unlikely to pay off.
An oak parquet floor sits at the core of the firm's established business, so its value is already fairly certain and further commitment is justified.
